Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About Advanced Hair Growth Pack Who should use this Advanced Hair Growth Pack? These Biotin Gummies & natural plant based hair serum can be used by anyone who is experiencing Stage 2 Hair Loss (more than 100 strands of hair fall per day & hair thinning on scalp). Use this pack for 6 months at least to see results. How does the Advanced Hair Growth Pack work? The Advanced Hair Growth Pack contains Hair Gummies and Hair Growth Serum. Our Hair Gummies contain essential multivitamins like Biotin, Zinc, and Vitamin A, C, and E that are crucial building blocks of hair and help curb hair fall. Our all natural Hair Growth Serum contains plant-based actives that stimulate hair follicles leading to hair growth. What is Biotin? Our hair is made of a protein called Keratin. Having sufficient keratin is important to keep the hair healthy and strong. Biotin (B7) helps in keratin synthesis. It's a vital supplement for hair loss treatment. How does Zinc help in hair fall? Zinc plays an important role in hair tissue growth and repair. Having Zinc supplements help treat hair loss caused by insufficient zinc. How do Redensyl & Anagain help in Hair Growth? Redensyl and Anagain are derived from plants, promote healthy hair growth by prolonging the anagen phase. They shorten the telogen phase, resulting in a significant decrease in hair loss. These natural actives for hair growth are often considered the best alternative to hair transplants due to their all-natural and non-hormonal hair regrowth qualities. How long should I use this pack? Use the pack everyday for: 3 months to stop hair fall 4 months to get baby hair growth 6 months for increase in hair volume & density. Since these are made from natural & plant based ingredients, they have no side effects Will this pack help in hair loss? Our Advanced Hair Growth Pack containing Biotin Hair Gummies & plant based Hair Growth Serum is an effective and vital solution for hair loss treatment. By just taking one gummy everyday, and applying our serum overnight for 3 months, you can see visible results in hair fall.In 6 months, you will see hair regrowth. Are your Hair gummies safe to eat? Yes, Hair gummies are 100% safe to eat! They have no preservatives and no artificial colour. They are also Vegan, Gluten Free and Gelatin Free.
